$comment: Fixture. Deliberately fails C12: declares orientation 'both' and requires keyExchangeSupported without requiring keyExchange, so it reports what the interface could negotiate and never what it does. A consumer reading the document would see a set of algorithms with no way to tell which of them is in use, and the capability attribute would quietly be read as present state. This is the failure orientation exists to catch. Everything else is well-formed.
title: Fixture - C12 capability without present state

objective.consumer: A fixture, standing in for a consumer.
objective.decision: Whether the checker requires present state alongside capability.
